title: pkg/tsdb scope: only 5 core (built-in) datasource backends remain
answers: Why can't I find the Prometheus/Loki/MySQL datasource backend in pkg/tsdb?
What datasources are 'core' vs external plugins?
body: pkg/tsdb/ holds Go backends only for Grafana's built-in (non-installable) datasource plugins: azuremonitor, cloudwatch, grafana-testdata-datasource, grafanads (the `-- Grafana --` special datasource), and graphite. All other datasources (Prometheus, Loki, MySQL, Elasticsearch, etc.) have been moved to separate plugin repos — don't expect to find or add them here. Each subpackage implements grafana-plugin-sdk-go `backend` handler interfaces (QueryDataHandler, CallResourceHandler, CheckHealthHandler, AdmissionHandler, sometimes StreamHandler) on a single `Service` struct, with an `instancemgmt.InstanceManager` caching per-instance settings/HTTP clients (e.g. pkg/tsdb/graphite/graphite.go:Service, ProvideService).
